Name: Enchanted Grove Farm
Author: Morghoula
Description:
[i][font=Arial]This custom farm map, inspired by SVE's "Enchanted Grove" area, was designed with both beauty and function in mind. At 120 x 120 tiles, it boasts plenty of room for you to freely plan your farm. There are very few ridges or terraces here - just lots of open meadows with breathtaking views! Fully customize your enchanting ambiance with fairies, crystals, mushrooms, and more!

[/font][/i][center][color=#6aa84f][size=4][font=Arial]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[/font][/size][/color][/center][center][font=Arial][color=#6aa84f][size=4]In collaboration with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/210387900]BogWyytch[/url]﻿, "Enchanted Grove Farm" now has seasonal forest background and mushroom options to match their foliage and buildings! Please go check them out and support their AMAZING work!

[img]https://s12.gifyu.com/images/StMqh.gif[/img]     [img]https://s12.gifyu.com/images/StMqk.gif[/img]
﻿
[font=Arial]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/font][/size][/color]
[font=Arial]
[/font]
[/font][/center][img]https://i.ibb.co/KjG9ptb/features.png[/img]
[list]
[*][font=Arial]Lots of open space (120 x 120 tiles) spread across 4 main quadrants.[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Many decorative features for the map which can be toggled on and off via GMCM or the config file.[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Seasonal tilesheets (and mushrooms that match if you have them enabled).[/font]
[*][font=Arial]A dock in the center of the map which allows you to swim in the lake to regain energy.[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Forage spawns.[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Stumps and logs to get your some hardwood early on (they do NOT respawn!)[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Access to the minecart system once repaired in the Community Center. [/font]
[*]NPC barriers around the foliage so your animals can't hide from you under it. Foliage can be walked under by the farmer.
[/list]
[b][u]To-Do
[/u][/b][list]
[*]Replace the crystals, water plants, and hanging vines with my own assets
[/list][font=Arial]

﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/XYdBFhX/installation.png[/img]
[color=#e69138][size=3][b]This map is only compatible on devices that have Stardew Valley 1.5 or later! Be sure to download the CORRECT version of this mod for the version of the game you are running. Read the descriptions under the 'Files' tab carefully![/b][/size][/color]

[color=#e8e6e3][size=2]Once you have downloaded and extracted the mod to your Stardew Valley/Mods folder, do the following:
[/size][/color][/font][list=1]
[*][font=Arial][color=#e8e6e3][size=2]Open Stardew Valley via SMAPI[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Arial][color=#e8e6e3][size=2]When creating a new save, you will see an option for an additional map called "Enchanted Grove Farm".[/size][/color][/font]
[/list][font=Arial]
[b][u][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]v1.6 Installation Notes[/size][/color][/u][/b][/font][size=3]
[/size][spoiler]
[list]
[*][u][font=Arial][color=#e8e6e3][size=2]If you have just updated to 1.6, you MUST start a new save to use this mod. This is true for all custom maps. Please do not report previous saves as having issues as there is no way around this.[/size][/color][/font][/u]
[*][font=Arial][color=#e8e6e3][size=2]The latest version (3.4.0+) changes some of the terrain. If you are playing on an existing save, you may need to reset bushes via the [url=https://github.com/Lake1059/ResetTerrainFeatures_NET6]Reset Terrain Features mod.[/url]﻿[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Arial][color=#e8e6e3][size=2]Before downloading the 1.6 version, delete the "[CP] Enchanted Grove Farm" and "[MP] Enchanted Grove Minecarts" (MinecartPatcher is no longer needed as custom minecarts are now integrated with SDV 1.6). Attempting to overwrite old folders may cause problems! Always make sure you are performing a fresh install for major mod updates![/size][/color][/font]
[/list][/spoiler]
[font=Arial]
[size=3][b][u]Adding compatibility with SVE Enchanted Grove Warps[/u]
[/b][/size][spoiler]
SVE now supports being able to modify the warp points from Enchanted Grove to custom farms. Here's how to modify SVE's settings to be compatible with this map:

[list=1]
[*]Open the "Stardew Valley Expanded" options in-game using GMCM
[*]Set "Warp Location" to "custom"
[*]In the "Custom Farm Map's MapName" field, enter "Enchanted_Grove_Farm" (without the quotes)
[*]Set the following properties:
[/list][list]
﻿"Enchanted Grove Warp X" = 114 ﻿"Enchanted Grove Warp Y" = 16[/list]If you do not have GMCM, you can also do this by opening the "config.json" file in the Stardew Valley Expanded mod (NOT this mod) and setting the values to the same properties there:

[code]  "WarpLocation": "custom",
  "Custom Farm Map's MapName": "Enchanted_Grove_Farm",
  "EnchantedGroveWarpX": "114",
  "EnchantedGroveWarpY": "16",[/code][size=2][/spoiler]
[/size]
